scenario.zh: 某航空零部件制造商需要采购一批钛合金紧固件,通过AI处理报价和供应商沟通
scenario.en: An aerospace parts manufacturer needs to procure titanium fasteners using AI for quotes and supplier communication

instruction.zh: 选择采购请求的复杂程度

output.zh: 已设定:钛合金紧固件,现有供应商库中匹配12家认证供应商
output.en: Set: titanium fasteners, matched 12 certified suppliers from existing network

output.zh: 已设定:定制航空级传感器支架,需要额外资质验证和技术规格审查
output.en: Set: custom aerospace sensor bracket, requires additional qualification and spec review

instruction.zh: 选择如何提供采购规格

output.zh: 已提取物料编号、数量和交付要求,AI识别出3个关键技术参数需供应商确认
output.en: Extracted part number, quantity and delivery terms, AI identified 3 key technical parameters for supplier confirmation

output.zh: AI解析图纸后生成规格摘要,标记了4处需与工程团队澄清的尺寸公差
output.en: AI parsed drawing and generated spec summary, flagged 4 dimensional tolerances for engineering clarification

instruction.zh: AI已向供应商发送询价并收到回复,选择优先考虑的因素
instruction.en: AI sent RFQs and received responses, choose priority factor

output.zh: 供应商A单价较低但交期较长,供应商B价格稍高但符合紧急交付需求
output.en: Supplier A offers lower unit price but longer lead time, Supplier B costs slightly more but meets urgent delivery

output.zh: 供应商C持有AS9100D认证且过往准时交付率高,供应商D认证较少但报价更优
output.en: Supplier C has AS9100D certification and strong on-time delivery history, Supplier D has fewer certs but better pricing

instruction.zh: 选择如何处理最终订单
instruction.en: Choose how to handle final order

output.zh: 已创建采购订单草稿并同步至ERP,等待采购经理审批后自动发送给供应商
output.en: Created PO draft and synced to ERP, awaiting procurement manager approval before auto-send to supplier

output.zh: 订单详情已整理为审查文档,AI标注了与历史采购价格的差异和风险提示
output.en: Order details compiled into review document, AI highlighted price variance from historical purchases and risk alerts

takeaway.zh: Axya通过AI处理采购流程中的报价对比和供应商沟通,减少人工操作并提升决策质量
takeaway.en: Axya uses AI to handle quote comparison and supplier communication in procurement, reducing manual work and improving decision quality
